idea-plugin.name: Claude Code Native
idea-plugin.description:
Claude Code in your IDE, with a real GUI — an AI coding agent for JetBrains, not a terminal wrapper. Chat, review every edit as a native IDE diff, and let the agent read and change your project under permissions you control. Runs your locally installed claude CLI over its stream-json protocol: no Node.js at runtime, no terminal window, no API key required if you already have a Claude subscription.

Works in any JetBrains IDE on the 2025.3 platform or newer — IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, RubyMine, CLion, Rider, DataGrip, DataSpell, Aqua and RustRover.

Unofficial, community-built, open-source plugin. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Anthropic or JetBrains. It requires the user's own separately-installed claude CLI and their own Claude subscription or API key — no credentials are bundled or provided.

Why this plugin

  • A real GUI, not a terminal. Streaming chat, collapsible tool calls, an inline permission card for every action — rendered natively, never mirrored CLI text
  • Diffs are real IDE diffs. Every file edit opens in the editor's own diff viewer and is editable before you approve it — tweak the agent's proposal, then accept
  • A deterministic security layer. Out-of-band code — not a prompt the model can talk its way past — checks every tool call before it runs
  • No Node.js, no SDK at runtime. Speaks the binary's protocol directly from Kotlin

Features

Streaming chat

  • Real-time token streaming with animated thinking indicator and live token counter
  • Multi-tab support — independent sessions per project
  • Multi-prompt queue: type while the agent is working, messages sent in order when the turn ends
  • /btw side-questions sent mid-turn without interrupting the active turn
  • Interrupt (Esc) to stop the current turn at any time

Full slash-command palette

  • All commands from the claude binary surfaced natively — type / in the composer or use the Commands toolbar button
  • Built-in /btw command added by the plugin
  • Signing in is a button, not a command to memorise: the welcome card and the dashboard's account row run the OAuth flow for you — no copy-pasting claude auth login into a shell (a typed /login still works)

Model & runtime controls

  • Model picker read straight from the binary, each entry showing its real version (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) — nothing hardcoded, new models appear on their own
  • Permission mode chip (default / acceptEdits / plan / bypassPermissions)
  • Effort chip (low / medium / high / xhigh / max) and adaptive extended thinking
  • Anthropic or DeepSeek as the provider, each with its own key in the IDE password safe
  • Advanced launch options: max turns, USD budget cap, fallback model, extra directories

Security — a deterministic tool-call lock

  • Every tool call is checked before any auto-approval, so it applies even in acceptEdits / bypassPermissions
  • Blocks reads of credentials and key material (SSH/GPG keys, cloud and database secrets, browser and password-manager stores, access tokens), credential-dumping and exfiltration commands, and access to other users' homes or network mounts
  • Deterministic code, not an LLM guardrail — there is no prompt that argues it into a Yes
  • Each rule is individually switchable in Settings; disabling one downgrades an automatic block to a permission card, never to a silent allow

Jump to code, and read it comfortably

  • File paths, directories and symbols in Claude's replies become clickable links — but only after the IDE confirms them, so a link is never dead
  • Syntax highlighting for diffs and file output, in your IDE's own colours
  • Executed shell commands render as their own copyable code block

Sessions, usage and MCP

  • Session history read from the binary's own files — reopen past chats, rename, fork; your open tabs are restored on IDE startup. The plugin never deletes your conversations: there is no delete action, on purpose
  • A tab per running agent: a session that spawns dozens of subagents and background tasks gives each one its own transcript instead of interleaving them all into the chat
  • Session dashboard: context breakdown, token usage and cost, your plan's usage limits with their reset times, account, and a Workloads view of every agent and background task
  • Optional MCP support — let Claude query the IDE through JetBrains' MCP server, or register your own MCP servers

Native diff review for file edits

  • When the agent requests to write or edit a file, a diff opens inline in the editor area
  • Non-modal Accept / Reject card in the chat — no popups or modal dialogs
  • On acceptance the binary writes the file; VFS is refreshed automatically

Permission & question handling

  • can_use_tool requests surface as native inline cards (Accept / Reject)
  • AskUserQuestion rendered as a structured question card with option buttons
  • Auto-approve in acceptEdits / bypassPermissions modes

IDE integration

  • Tool window anchored to the right panel (same area as AI Assistant)
  • Right-click to Explain with Claude, or add the current selection or file as context
  • Attach files, directories, the current selection, or paste and drag-drop images
  • The IDE sees the agent's writes immediately — no stale editors, no manual refresh
  • Follows your IDE theme, light and dark, with custom icons on every tool call

Requirements

  • JetBrains IDE 2025.3 or newer (build 253+). 2025.1 and 2025.2 are not supported: the whole chat UI is an embedded browser (JCEF), and 2025.3 is the first release where the platform exposes it as a declarable module — which is what keeps the plugin working on 2026.2, where JCEF moved out of the IDE core into a bundled plugin of its own
  • claude CLI installed and on PATH or ~/.local/bin/ (npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code)
  • A Claude subscription (Pro / Max / Team / Enterprise) or an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
